name: apiary-rebuild-v5
description: The Apiary rebuild's ACTION layer, switched off. READ THIS BEFORE READING THE ARM. A suit rebuild is a data-and-handler change, not a set of numbers, so NO OVERLAY CAN EXPRESS "the Apiary suit as it was" - the old suit printed the Hired Worker system on three cards and a crop waiver on its Farmstead, and neither is a knob. This arm therefore isolates the ONE piece of the rebuild an overlay can reach: A13 The Queen's Hive, A14 The Honeycomb Tower and A15 The Royal Apiary, the three Tier 3 ACTION cards. What it measures is what the action layer is worth, and above all what the COIN FAUCET is worth - A14 is the first repeatable one in the game (risk 2) and A15 hands out five cards for £10, and the pair are the only reason the market has ever had to exist. So read this cell for: market buys per game (was 0.1), coins minted by A14 per game, the coin-flood assertion, and total coins in play. Everything else is before-and-after against the committed reference run, not against this cell - the two conditions that DECIDE the rebuild (Apiary's mean card play rate up from 19.9%, and its win rate up from 20.7% toward the 37.5% even share) and every diagnostic: activations per Apiary turn, the round of a seat's first activation (risk 1, the cold start), ACTIVATIONS OF A FULL BUILDING - which matters more than the win rate, because if it is near zero the design's central claim is wrong and the suit needs a harvest valve after all - activations of foreign-crop buildings (risk 5), cards into an Apiary seat's barn (risk 4, against Dairy's 10.2 and Orchard's 25.7), A10 and A11 up from 5%, A13/A14/A15 up sharply from the Tier 3 baseline of about 2%, and Tier 3 firings per card built up from 0.63. GUARDRAILS THAT MUST NOT MOVE: reshuffles per played deck flat at 5 to 8 (A13 and A15 each take five deck tops in one action), clog as denial at 0.5% / 0.1% / 0.0% (A14 and A4 both push on it, and the dial if it moves is to stop a neighbour's Notice Board and Service being legal sow targets), the barn glut, visits per turn at or above 0.51, and the bonus-slot mix still at least 70% visit. RUN THE TIER 3 ARM AND THE TIER 1 REBUILD AS SEPARATE SWEEPS: the activation seam and the coin faucet fix different faults and will otherwise be credited to each other. Read the noise floor before believing any of it. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
